    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String s = sc.next();
        
        boolean inParentheses = false;
        StringBuilder currentSegment = new StringBuilder();
        int maxLengthOutside = 0;
        int countInside = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(') {
                if (!inParentheses) {
                    processSegment(currentSegment.toString(), maxLengthOutside, (len) -> maxLengthOutside = len);
                    currentSegment.setLength(0);
                }
                inParentheses = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inParentheses = false;
                String[] parts = currentSegment.toString().split("_");
                for (String part : parts) {
                    if (!part.isEmpty()) {
                        countInside++;
                    }
                }
                currentSegment.setLength(0);
            } else {
                currentSegment.append(c);
            }
        }
        
        processSegment(currentSegment.toString(), maxLengthOutside, (len) -> maxLengthOutside = len);
        System.out.println(maxLengthOutside + " " + countInside);
    }
    
    private static void processSegment(String segment, int currentMax, java.util.function.IntConsumer updateMax) {
        if (!segment.isEmpty()) {
            String[] words = segment.split("_");
            for (String word : words) {
                if (word.length() > currentMax) {
                    updateMax.accept(word.length());
                }
            }
        }
    }

        boolean inParens = false;
        StringBuilder temp = new StringBuilder();
        int longestOutside = 0;
        int insideCount = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                    temp.setLength(0);

                inParens = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inParens = false;
                String[] parts = temp.toString().split("_");
                for (String part : parts) {
                    if (!part.isEmpty()) insideCount++;
                }
                temp.setLength(0);
            } else {

            }

        longestOutside = Math.max(longestOutside, findMaxWordLength(temp.toString()));

    private static int findMaxWordLength(String text) {
        if (text.isEmpty()) return 0;
        int max = 0;
        for (String word : text.split("_")) {
            max = Math.max(max, word.length());
        }
        return max;
    }
